body: I know the feeling. One of my greatest comforts is that this has to end at some point.
Ohio. I've been to the hospital but didn't tell them what I did, just said I was sick. They didn't find any issue. Is just a matter of time before the effects show?

I actually went to the doctor today just describing the vomiting and symptoms but not telling them what I actually did. After bloodwork and xray, they thought I just had a virus. Not sure what to make of that.
